title: fix: restore JSON for Gemini search and add Vercel fallback
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores search + JSON/schema for `google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:search`: OpenRouter AI Studio [Exa plugin](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/features/plugins/web-search) primary; hidden Vercel/Google fallback uses the same model. Preserves nine aliases, paid-only access and multiplier 1; no Pollinations GPU. Follow-up to #16593.
- Search cost change: the plugin searches every uncached request unless disabled. [Exa](https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/models-and-providers/web-search) costs $7/1K searches; listing price is $7.385/1K plus generation. Cache hits add no charges.
- Billing change: opt-in reported totals include search and override token estimates; adjustment breakdowns remain informational. OpenRouter cost includes its 5.5% purchase fee. Vercel retains the listing's 5.5% uplift as margin. The plugin reports dollars but no search counter; primary search-count reporting remains unavailable.
- Vercel JSON bills both generations and can perform multiple billed searches: preparation budget is max(max_tokens, 2048), while max_tokens limits the final answer. Empty search answers fail with 502 before formatting; a live empty-answer response confirmed this. Gateway metadata filtering is limited to Vercel-served responses; other streams pass through unchanged.
- Passes 317 Gen tests, 65 pricing/snapshot tests, both typechecks and full live E2E: JSON/streaming, media, aliases, opt-out, permissions, ten concurrent requests/route, response/prompt caches, and 115 reconciled staging events with zero quarantine. Both routes use Exa. No deployments/secrets changed.

gist.headline: Search finds its braces
gist.blurb: Gemini search and JSON make up. Exa handles the searching, with a second route ready when the first needs help.
gist.summary: Restores JSON and schema responses for `google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:search` using OpenRouter's Exa search plugin, with a hidden Vercel/Google fallback on the same model and billing that includes reported search costs.
gist.impact: Paid users get search with structured JSON or streaming responses across both routes; uncached requests search unless disabled, at a listed $7.385 per 1,000 searches plus generation, while cache hits add no search charge.
